items.markdown:
![Pad Thai Recipe](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07290608-1672-0139-0000-21d89b72db21:6)
Thai food is `the national cuisine of Thailand, famous for its bright balance of sweet, sour, salty, and spicy tastes` . It relies on fresh herbs, aromatic roots, and rice as a main base.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thai_cuisine) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thai_cuisine)[[2]](https://www.deevaandfood.com/post/traditional-thai-food/)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/100063832454256/videos/thai-food-is-the-national-cuisine-of-thailand-and-is-known-for-its-unique-flavor/3754585741461016/)[[4]](https://www.thecookingacademy.co.uk/thai-cookery-class/)

Key Flavors and Ingredients

- **Flavors:** Every dish aims to mix spicy, sweet, salty, and sour elements.
- **Herbs and Spices:** Lemongrass, galangal, cilantro, and Thai basil create strong, fresh smells.
- **Sauces:** Fish sauce and soy sauce add deep salty and savory flavor.
- **Staple Base:** Jasmine rice or sticky rice is served with almost every meal.[](https://www.deevaandfood.com/post/traditional-thai-food/) [[1]](https://thaiwhiteelephant.co.uk/thai-food-what-is-it-and-how-healthy-is-it/)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/100063832454256/videos/thai-food-is-the-national-cuisine-of-thailand-and-is-known-for-its-unique-flavor/3754585741461016/)[[3]](https://mysticthaijamaica.com/why-thai-food-feels-balanced-even-when-flavors-are-bold/)[[4]](https://thaibananaleaf.com/aromatic-herbs-in-thai-food/)

Famous Dishes

- **Pad Thai:** Stir-fried rice noodles with eggs, tofu, peanuts, and a choice of meat or shrimp.
- **Tom Yum:** A hot and sour clear soup packed with herbs and shrimp.
- **Green Curry:** A rich and spicy curry made with a base of coconut milk and green chili paste.
- **Som Tam:** A crunchy, spicy, and sour green papaya salad.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thai_cuisine) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7psre5iGaB4&t=31)[[2]](https://thecultureur.com/bon-appetit-15-foods-must-try-thailand/)[[3]](https://pickyourtrail.com/tourism/thailand/best-thailand-dishes)[[4]](https://www.thai-food-online.co.uk/blogs/thai-food-online-blog/tom-yum-thai-soup-recipe)
